title: Running Commentary on Torah 51 — Avnei Shayish Tahor
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 51 — אבני שיש טהור
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"Amar R' Akiva: 'k'she'atem magi'in l'avnei shayish tahor, al tomru: mayim mayim, she'ne'emar: dovair shekarim lo yikkon l'neged einai'"** (Tehillim 101:7; Chagigah 14b: the Pardes episode — those entering the mystical orchard must not call what they see 'water, water' when they reach the pure marble stones, for sheker unsettles the vision). **"**Sheker damages the eyes physically and spiritually** — **'u'm'shakros einayim'** (Yeshayahu 3:16). When eyes are **kehos** (dimmed), they lie — they show a large thing as small, one as two — the opposite of truth. Eyes become kehos from **dim'os** (tears) — Chazal (Shabbos 151b on 'v'yashuvu he'avim achar ha'gashem,' Kohelet 12:2): **'zeh ha'ma'or ha'chozer achar ha'b'chi'** — sight returns after crying (i.e., cries weaken sight)."**

intermediate.en: **R' Akiva (Chagigah 14b)**: at avnei shayish tahor, say not "mayim mayim" ("dovair shekarim lo yikkon l'neged einai," Teh 101:7). Sheker damages eyes (Yesh 3:16 "m'shakros einayim"); eyes kehos → lie. Dim'os weaken sight (Shab 151b on Koh 12:2).
intermediate.he: **ר"ע (חג' יד:)**: באבני שיש טהור לא לומר "מים מים" ("דובר שקרים", תה' קא, ז). שקר מזיק לעיניים (יש' ג, טז "משקרות עיניים"); עיניים כהות → משקרות. דמעות מכהות (שב' קנא: על קה' יב, ב).

scholarly.he: סעיף א. חג' יד:; תה' קא, ז; יש' ג, טז; שב' קנא:.

beginner.en: **"**The birth of sheker=ra=tum'ah** comes from **distance from Echad**. Ra is **negdiyus** (opposition) — whatever is against a person's ratzon is ra; but **in Echad, there's no negdiyus — all is tov**. Chazal (Pesachim 50a on Zechariah 14:9): **'ba'yom ha'hu yihyeh Hashem echad... kulo ha'tov v'ha'meitiv'** — because in Echad, no ra is possible. Hence l'asid: **'sfas emes tikkon la'ad'** (Mishlei 12:19) — all will be Echad, all tov. Emes is Echad: a silver vessel called 'silver vessel' = truth; 'gold vessel' = sheker — because 'gold' is **other-than**, distance from Echad."**

intermediate.en: **β. Sheker=ra=tum'ah from distance from Echad**. "Ba'yom ha'hu yihyeh Hashem echad — kulo tov" (Pes 50a; Zech 14:9). L'asid "sfas emes tikkon" (Mishlei 12:19). Emes=Echad (correspondence of name to thing).
intermediate.he: **β. שקר=רע=טומאה מריחוק מאחד**. "ביום ההוא יהיה ה' אחד — כולו טוב" (פס' נ.; זכ' יד, ט). לעתיד "שפת אמת תיכון" (מש' יב, יט). אמת=אחד.

scholarly.he: פס' נ.; זכ' יד, ט; מש' יב, יט.

beginner.en: **"**Before briyah**, when briyah was b'koach, all was Echad, all Emes, all Tov, all Kodesh. Even **'tahor' wasn't applicable** — tahor only relates to there being tum'ah (**'v'taharu'** — **'mi'kol tum'oseichem,'** Yechezkel 36:25). When all is Echad, no category of **cheshbonos rabim** — which is the root of ra/tum'ah. **Taharah is ha'mematze'a bein kodesh v'tum'ah** (the mediating bechina); via it tum'ah is rectified. = Bechirah = **koach ha'bechirah** — also a mediating bechina between tov and ra."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Before briyah (b'koach)**=Echad=Emes=Tov=Kodesh; tahor not applicable (only vs tum'ah; Yech 36:25). Cheshbonos rabim=root ra/tum'ah. Taharah=mediating bechina=bechirah.
intermediate.he: **γ. לפני הבריאה (בכוח)**=אחד=אמת=טוב=קודש; טהור לא שייך (רק לעומת טומאה; יחז' לו, כה). חשבונות רבים=שורש רע/טומאה. טהרה=בחינה ממצעת=בחירה.

beginner.en: **"(Shayach to above):** Hence sheker damages eyes: **sheker removes Hashem's hashgachah** (eyes = hashgachah). Sheker comes from distance from Echad (= root of tum'ah). By lying, he **pogems the One** and causes hashgachah to withdraw. Via Hashem's hashgachah, **all is Echad** after briyah as before. Sheker blemishes Echad and removes hashgachah."**

intermediate.en: Sheker damages eyes=hashgachah. Sheker=distance from Echad → pogem Echad → hashgachah withdraws. Hashem's hashgachah makes post-briyah = pre-briyah Echad.
intermediate.he: שקר פוגע בעיניים=השגחה. שקר=ריחוק מאחד → פוגם באחד → הסתלקות השגחה. השגחת ה' משווה אחר־בריאה ללפני־בריאה אחד.
